svg.title: What install writes, what you edit and what you set on GitHub
svg.desc: install of a release, run in the root of the repository, writes the four workflows, the workflow of the discussions where answer_categories of config.toml names a category, the firewall policy .github/egress-firewall.yaml and an entry in .gitignore; adds the notice to reporters to SUPPORT.md and the queue of issue-assistant.yml to actionlint's settings where they are missing; and writes starters of project.md, config.toml, labels.toml, findings.toml and a bug report form when they are missing. With --setup, it also creates the environment issue-assistant on GitHub, limited to the default branch, and asks for the engine's secret. Then you describe the project in project.md, adapt the starters, and turn off the auto-close of issues by merged pull requests. Then check passes, and a run by hand shows the first analysis as a dry run.
